content: गोष्पदम् .²1 A cowʼs foot. .²2 The mark or impression of a cowʼs foot in the soil. .²3 The quantity of water sufficient to fill such an impression; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} a very small puddle; गोष्पदे संप्लुतोदके <ls>Mb. 1. 31. 9</ls>. ˚प्रम् (णमुल्) in such a manner that a cowʼs footprint be filled; ददाल भूर्नभो रक्तं गोष्पदप्रं ववर्ष च <ls>Bk. 14. 20</ls>. .²4 As much as a cows foot-step will hold. .²5 A spot frequented by cows.
